steps.title: Names
steps.body: Each square has a name: a letter for the file (a to h) and a number for the rank (1 to 8). Pieces use letters: K king, Q queen, R rook, B bishop, N knight. Pawns have no letter.

steps.title: Reading moves
steps.body: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 means: pawn to e4, pawn to e5, then knight to f3.

steps.question: What does Nf3 mean?
steps.explanation: N stands for knight. Pawns have no letter, so e4 means a pawn to e4.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.body: Play the pawn from d2 to d4. In notation, that is d4.
steps.hint: The pawn on d2 can move two squares on its first move.
